description: Get a Stripe Checkout link to keep Clara after the trial — Pro by default, the plan every trial runs on. Requires the secret_key from create_trial_tenant, either as the secret_key argument or an "Authorization: Bearer <secret_key>" header.

secret_key.description: The secret_key returned by create_trial_tenant, if your client can't send it as an "Authorization: Bearer <secret_key>" header instead.

tier.description: Optional; defaults to "pro". Pass only if the owner asked for a different plan.

name: get_upgrade_link
title: Get Upgrade Link
